meta.app: CK2 Art Bot pack_atlas_underlay.py (TexturePacker JSON Hash compatible)
meta.model: R4f underlay, top-wing assembly hidden (round4/src/ck2car_r4.py + spec410.py, Matthew-approved 2026-11-21 11:25 PM, locked). Garage only, not part of the race atlas.
meta.layerSpec: single channel 8-bit, chrome/specular amount (premultiplied by coverage); half res of the albedo frame, same 6.8 m window
meta.pivotMeaning: ground point directly under the rear-axle centre; same pixel as the car bake and the closeup overlay pivot
meta.heading0: nose pointing up the screen, away from the grandstand, increasing clockwise (same as the car bake)
meta.frameOrder: index = headingIndex (headings 045,090,135,225,315); one page per layer
meta.keyLight: R4 scene, fixed for all frames: key sun 3.8 (12 deg disc) from screen upper-left ~62 deg high, two large area fill banks, sky 0.6; shadow layer = key sun only
meta.tint: linear: m = mask; stripe = 1 - m.a; rgb = albedo.rgb * mix(1, primary/0.8, m.r) * mix(1, secondary/0.8, m.g) * mix(1, panel/0.8, m.b) * mix(1, stripe/0.8, stripe); alpha = albedo.a; then rgb += specGlint (from the spec layer, added AFTER the tint and NOT tinted)
meta.maskNote: R5b 4-region: R primary/deck, G secondary, B number panel, stripe = 1-A. A = 255 except on the stripe, including empty space. Coverage from albedo.a. No wing number panels (the top wing is hidden).
meta.hideNote: Hidden: every child of top_wing (foil, sideboards, wicker, wing numbers) and the top_wing empty. Kept: slider rails, front/rear posts, stays, wing cylinder (cage-mounted). Nose wing kept. Posts stay at the locked 24.5° attachment; the front-post deck mount is the closeup tilt pivot so front posts still meet the overlay wing. Rear posts do not extend with notch.
meta.shadowNote: Underlay shadow is the car without the top-wing assembly (posts still cast). The wing closeup atlas carries the wing-only ground shadow. Runtime combine on the car grid: density = 1 - (1-underlay)*(1-closeup_wing), then the usual 0.6 runtime alpha. Closeup shadow placement uses the closeup overlay origin, with scale 1.0 onto the 192 px / 6.8 m car frame (see wing closeup README).
